Day 1: Arrival in Barcelona. Arrive at 10 AM and explore the city.
Day 2: Day trip to Sitges. Take the train to Sitges, explore the old town and beaches, then return to Barcelona.
Day 3: Barcelona. Spend the day exploring Barcelona.
Day 4: Travel to Valencia. Take the train to Valencia and explore.
Day 5: Day trip to Peñíscola. Visit Peñíscola Castle, the beach, and the old town, then return to Valencia.
Day 6: Valencia. Explore and beach.
Day 7: Travel to Madrid. Take the train to Madrid, explore the city.
Day 8: Day trip to Toledo. Explore Toledo, then return to Madrid.
Day 9: Madrid. Explore the city and in the evening, take the train back to Barcelona.
Day 10: Departure. Early morning flight home.
